stories.title: Hackers now exploit critical Drupal RCE flaw to hijack sites
stories.summary: The Drupal security team has confirmed that a critical vulnerability that lets attackers hijack unpatched sites has been actively exploited since at least Thursday.

stories.title: Drupal Fail2Install Exploit Details Emerge as Critical RCE Flaw Faces Active Exploitation
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday added a critical flaw impacting Drupal to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, requiring federal agencies to apply the fixes by November 27, 2026. stories.title: Hackers Exploit Two GeoServer Flaws as Researchers Warn of Unauthenticated RCE Chains
stories.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting two newly patched security flaws in GeoServer, according to watchTowr. stories.title: Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension
stories.summary: The Remus infostealer is stealing Gmail messages through a stealthy malicious Chrome extension, a capability the malware operators marketed as a zero-day exploit in Google's email service.

stories.title: 1Password Hacked, Customer Data and Source Code Stolen in GitHub Account Breach
stories.summary: Popular password management software 1Password on Wednesday disclosed a security incident involving its backend systems that led to the unauthorized access of some customer information, but emphasized that customer password vaults and other secrets were not accessed. stories.title: Drupal Warns of New Highly Critical Site Takeover Vulnerability Under Active Exploitation
stories.summary: Drupal has warned of a new "highly critical" security flaw impacting Drupal core that it said has been exploited in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-136716 (CVSS score: N/A), has been described as a case of improper checking for unusual or exceptional conditions. It also relates to CVE-2026-132165 aka Fail2Install in that it addresses remaining vulnerable installation states

stories.title: Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks
stories.summary: Accenture says hackers exploited MiCollab flaws before Mitel’s advisory, likely aided by AI, in a suspected extortion campaign.

stories.title: Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack
stories.summary: Attackers are probing GeoServer instances for two high-severity flaws that can be chained with other bugs for unauthenticated RCE.
